case.title: Planning a shared-equipment workshop
case.brief: Develop a small learning tool for a fictional workshop volunteer who must plan an activity using shared equipment while respecting availability, support and participant needs. Let the learner inspect facts, propose a plan, receive feedback and revise when conditions change. A user must be able to replace the case facts.
constraints: Use fictional stock, people and operating rules only.
Do not infer participant needs that have not been supplied.
Prefer a feasible alternative or request for clarification when the original plan cannot work.
requirements: Connect the proposed plan to the actual available resources and stated constraints.
Support a reasoned fallback when equipment or assistance is unavailable.
Explain uncertainty and avoid treating a preferred plan as proof of learning.

Executable browser contract: expose scenario JSON in textarea #scenario-input and apply it with button #apply-scenario. Show the applied case in #scenario-view. Provide editable learner response #response-input, button #try-response, visible feedback #feedback, button #revise-response, button #skip-practice, button #reset-practice and visible state #practice-status. Scenario JSON has title, facts (string array), constraints (string array), and task. Read these as data; do not expect particular fixture content. The interface supports automated observation and user updates; it does not prescribe which instructional feedback strategy to use. Use explicit labels, keyboard-operable buttons and visible recoverable errors. No network requests or external assets.

scenarios.title: Enough equipment for the planned activity
scenarios.brief: Test the frozen tool under these supplied fictional conditions; judge observed behavior and capability support.

conditions.human_time_note: The time constraint is a fictional operating condition; scripted execution does not establish human completion time.

task.title: Enough equipment for the planned activity
facts: Six participants work in three pairs.
Three complete kits and one facilitator are available.
The activity requires one kit per pair.
task.task: Propose a feasible kit allocation and explain how participants will get help.

value.title: Enough equipment for the planned activity
facts: Six participants work in three pairs.
Three complete kits and one facilitator are available.
The activity requires one kit per pair.
value.task: Propose a feasible kit allocation and explain how participants will get help.

actions.value: Give every participant a kit; the stock will cover it.
Use three pairs with one kit per pair. Explain the task, make the facilitator support route clear, and check whether anyone needs another way to participate.

checks.expected: Enough equipment for the planned activity

scenarios.interpretation: Mechanical checks describe browser behavior. The expert evaluator must inspect the actual inputs, outputs and case facts; a success label alone is not evidence of learning.

task.title: A kit becomes unavailable
facts: Only two complete kits are currently available.
A facilitator can support one group at a time.
constraints: Allow a meaningful alternative while a pair waits.
A changed plan must not invent a third kit.
task.task: Revise the activity plan to use two kits without excluding the waiting pair.

value.title: A kit becomes unavailable
facts: Only two complete kits are currently available.
A facilitator can support one group at a time.
constraints: Allow a meaningful alternative while a pair waits.
A changed plan must not invent a third kit.
value.task: Revise the activity plan to use two kits without excluding the waiting pair.

actions.value: Keep all three pairs on kits simultaneously; assume another kit appears.
Use two pairs on kits and one pair on a related planning or observation task, then rotate. State how the waiting pair participates and when facilitator help is available.

task.title: Equipment and support are interrupted
facts: The facilitator is unavailable for the next ten minutes.
Six participants still need a useful activity, and no extra kit can be obtained now.
constraints: The page must work without connectivity.
Keyboard access, skipping and recovery are required.
Do not start an activity that the supplied facts say requires absent supervision.
task.task: Decide what can proceed, what should wait, and how to communicate a feasible alternative.

value.title: Equipment and support are interrupted
facts: The facilitator is unavailable for the next ten minutes.
Six participants still need a useful activity, and no extra kit can be obtained now.
constraints: The page must work without connectivity.

value.task: Decide what can proceed, what should wait, and how to communicate a feasible alternative.

actions.value: Start all kit tasks immediately and count completion as readiness.

Pause any kit task that requires the missing facilitator. Offer a clearly bounded planning or observation alternative, explain the resource limit, and schedule supervised kit practice when support returns.
